name: What permits are required for multi-family renovations in California?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for multi-family renovations in California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multi-family renovations in California typically require a range of permits from local building and planning departments, which can vary slightly by city (e.g., Los Angeles vs. Pasadena). Common requirements include building permits for structural changes, electrical permits for wiring upgrades, plumbing permits for new fixtures, and mechanical permits for HVAC systems. Depending on the project, you might also need permits for grading, demolitions, or environmental review.
